name: SSDD SAR Ship Detection
description: SAR Ship Detection Dataset (SSDD), official open release. Synthetic-aperture-radar ship detection from Sentinel-1, RadarSat-2 and TerraSAR-X imagery (nadir spaceborne, HH/VV/VH/HV polarizations, 1-15 m resolution). 1160 images, 2587 ship instances, single class 'ship'. Official train(928)/test(232) split, with the official test set used as the validation split here. Source: Zhang, T. et al., 'SAR Ship Detection Dataset (SSDD): Official Release and Comprehensive Data Analysis', Remote Sensing 2021, 13(18), 3690. Official release github.com/TianwenZhang0825/Official-SSDD under Apache-2.0. Horizontal bounding boxes (BBox-SSDD) converted from COCO to YOLO. Far-from-COCO radar modality.
